ABOUT THE ARTIST

Durel William Etimbe

Durel Creative Studio is the creative brand of Durel William Etimbe, an artist and visual designer with hands-on experience in painting, decorative finishes, portrait work and interior artistic décor. The studio brings traditional drawing and painting skills into flexible digital services including custom portraits, printable artwork, line-art illustrations and practical design products. Each commission is created with attention to detail, clean presentation and the client’s personal vision.

Brand: DE(Desert Eagle)Artz

Studio: Durel Creative Studio
